cities.name: Tirana
cities.local_food_tip: Tavë kosi, byrek, qofte, fërgesë — Balkan flavors with Albanian spices and local ingredients.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌞 Skanderbeg Square & National History Museum → Walk through colorful streets with murals and small cafés. → Coffee and byrek in the Blloku district.

Afternoon: 🕌 Visit Et'hem Bey Mosque and Clock Tower → Lunch: Tavë kosi (baked lamb with yogurt) or qofte with fresh salad. → Relax in the Grand Park (Parku i Madh) or by Tirana’s artificial lake.

Sunset: 🌇 Take the cable car up Dajti Mountain — panoramic view over Tirana at golden hour.

Night: 🌃 Explore Blloku’s nightlife — street food, music bars, or relaxed café atmosphere.

ideas: 🌸 Walks in Grand Park — blossoming trees and sunny days.
🎨 Street‑art tours around the city center.
☕ Outdoor cafés in quiet neighborhoods.
🌆 Evening strolls through illuminated streets and parks.
🍦 Ice cream or fruit drinks in Blloku.
🎶 Summer concerts and open‑air music events.
🍂 Walks through parks with autumn leaves.
🍲 Traditional meals in taverns — perfect for cooler days.
🏛️ Visit museums and galleries when weather is unpredictable.
☕ Warm drinks and homemade pastries in cozy cafés.
🛍️ Christmas markets and local crafts in the city center.
🌙 Quiet evening walks through softly lit streets.

public_transport_tips: 🚌 Use city buses — most of central Tirana is well‑connected.
🚶 The center is compact and walkable — ideal for sightseeing on foot.
🚡 The cable‑car to Dajti Mountain offers a quick nature escape.
📱 Check local apps or maps for updated routes and schedules.

cities.name: Berat
cities.local_food_tip: Fërgesë me piperka, stuffed peppers, homemade bread and local wine — rustic and warm inland Albanian flavors.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌅 Stroll through Mangalem & Gorica — iconic Ottoman‑era houses with white façades and wooden balconies. → Visit the thousand‑year‑old Berat Castle with towers and panoramic views. → Coffee break by the Osum river in an old‑town tavern.

Afternoon: 🏛️ Visit Onufri National Iconographic Museum inside the castle → Lunch: traditional dish with local wine. → Scenic walk to Gorica Bridge and riverside paths.

Sunset: 🌇 Hilltop viewpoint above the castle — golden hour over the town and the river.

Night: 🌙 Lantern‑lit stone streets, simple tavern dinner and peaceful old‑town atmosphere.

ideas: 🌼 Gardens and riverbanks blooming with spring flowers.
🚶 Quiet walks through historic alleys before tourist season begins.
📸 Photography of white houses, old bridges and soft spring light.
🛶 Short rafting or swimming on the Osum river nearby (for the adventurous).
🌇 Evening strolls beside the river and dinner on a terrace.
🍨 Ice cream and light meals after sightseeing.
🍁 Golden foliage and calm atmosphere in old town — ideal for photos.
🍷 Wine tasting and traditional meals in cozy taverns.
🥘 Comforting hot dishes and local specialties by the fireplace.
🌨️ Mists over the river — mystical ambiance around the old town.
☕ Hot drinks and homemade desserts in stone taverns.
🕯️ Evening walks through silent cobblestone streets under lantern light.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Minibuses from Tirana or Durrës are the most common access routes.
🚶 The old town is compact and walkable — ideal for exploring on foot.
🚗 Taxis or private transfer can be useful for late arrivals.
📅 Best time to visit: spring or autumn — fewer crowds and mild climate.

city_events.name: Berat Castle Festival
city_events.description: 🎭 Music and cultural events within the medieval fortress walls.

city_events.name: Autumn Wine & Food Days
city_events.description: 🍷 Tasting of local wines and traditional dishes — a celebration of harvest and heritage.

cities.name: Durrës
cities.local_food_tip: Fresh seafood, Mediterranean salads and grilled meats — typical coastal mediterranean meals beside the sea.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌅 Early beach walk or stroll along the shore → Visit the Roman amphitheatre and Archaeological Museum. → Coffee by the sea.

Afternoon: 🏖️ Beach time — swimming, sunbathing, sea breeze. → Lunch at a seaside restaurant with fresh fish or seafood. → Walk along the port or promenade toward sunset.

Sunset: 🌇 Evening stroll along the coast, enjoy a gelato or drink by the water.

Night: 🎶 Nightlife by the sea — bars, live music or relaxed seaside dinners.

ideas: 🌸 Early strolls along the coast — calm sea and soft weather.
🐚 Collect seashells or explore coastal nature before tourist season.
☕ Morning coffee with sea view and fresh air.
🏖️ Full days at the beach: swimming, tanning, relaxing by the sea.
🍦 Ice cream and light seafood meals near the shore.
🌙 Night parties, music and seaside social life under stars.
🍂 Quiet walks along the seafront, gentle sea breeze and peaceful coast.
🥘 Warm seafood dinners and coastal meals at sunset.
📸 Photography of sea calm and reflective waters.
🌬️ Brisk seaside walks with fresh sea air and peaceful coast.
🔥 Warm drinks and hearty meals in cozy coastal cafés.
🕯️ Reflective evening walks by the sea — quiet, calm and relaxing.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Buses and minibus lines connect Durrës with Tirana and other regions.
🚶 The city center and beach are walkable — easy to explore without car.
🚗 Having a car gives flexibility to explore nearby beaches and coastal areas.
🎟️ During high season, arrive early to secure good beach spots.

city_events.name: Durrës Summer Beach Festival
city_events.description: 🎉 Beach parties, music, water sports and seaside gatherings.

city_events.name: Autumn Sea & History Days

cities.name: Gjirokastër
cities.local_food_tip: Qifqi (rice balls), cheese pies, local wine and honey — homemade specialties of the Gjirokastër region.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏰 Walk through cobblestone streets and historic stone houses → Visit Gjirokastër Castle with panoramic mountain and valley views. → Coffee break in a traditional tavern with local pastry.

Afternoon: 🖼️ Visit the Ethnographic Museum (former Ottoman-era home) → Lunch: qifqi or pie with local wine and fresh salad. → Walk or hike to nearby hills for extra scenic views.

Sunset: 🌇 View from castle walls at dusk — panorama of stone rooftops and rolling hills.

Night: 🌙 Quiet stroll through lantern‑lit old town, maybe live folk music in a tavern — genuine village‑town atmosphere.

ideas: 🌼 Spring scents among stone houses and narrow streets.
📸 Photographing historic town against green hills background.
☕ Tavern terraces with sunshine and quiet afternoons.
🎶 Folk music or small concerts in the castle courtyard under the stars.
🌅 Sunset from hilltops above town — breathtaking views.
🍨 Light meals and drinks outdoors after day trips.
🍂 Empty stone streets and calm atmosphere — ideal for reflective walks.
🍷 Wine tasting and home‑style meals in local taverns.
📚 Visits to museums and cultural spots in cozy indoor settings.
🌫️ Foggy mornings and a mystical vibe among old stone houses.
🔥 Warm home‑cooked meals and local wine after cold walks.
🕯️ Evening strolls under lantern‑light in the silent, historic town.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Regional buses from Tirana or coastal towns — common public‑transport access.
🚶 Old town is best explored on foot — narrow, stone streets are pedestrian‑friendly.
🚗 For nearby villages or countryside — renting a car gives you freedom.
🎒 Wear good shoes — cobblestones and hills are part of the historic charm.

city_events.description: 🎶 Traditional music and dance nights in the castle courtyard under the sky.

Sunset: 🌅 Walk along lake embankment — perfect golden hour and peaceful waters.

Night: 🌃 Relax by the water, enjoy traditional music in a local tavern or take a calm evening walk through quiet streets.
